summary:
Dependency censuses must include tracked .proj receiver files, not only ordinary projects and lockfiles. Templates851 exposed a Kit/CLI coherence omission and the separate optional Governance receiver. Resolve and qualify the declared receiver without changing its opt-in or ownership semantics.

Treat a generated-workspace dependency change as a coherent producer/checker update: source declarations, selected current payload digest allowlists, generated integrity checks, packaged helper aliases and separate source-provenance digests must agree. A shared helper can have multiple packed aliases; checking only its authoring path misses a stale digest consumer. Preserve existing accepted source identities in explicitly historical controls rather than changing historical expected packages or suppressing their failure to make a current upgrade pass.

These findings are anchored to accepted merge9ef3495 and source-batch acceptance https://github.com/FS-GG/FS.GG.Templates/issues/851#issuecomment-6590770494 . They describe source qualification and its boundaries, not package publication, installed fleet adoption or acceptance of historical native controls. Refresh live owners and exact source before further action.
title: Dependency upgrades include receivers, producer checks and packed aliases
